header: What each unit costs on top of the plan
lead: Only four things are counted, and none of them is a patient or an appointment. Everything else in Talbrunn is inside the monthly price.
note: Metered items appear as separate lines on the monthly invoice, with the count for the period beside each. Figures are net; 20 % VAT is added on the invoice.

rates.title: SMS appointment reminder
rates.text: Per message actually sent. Reminders that fail are not counted.

rates.title: Printed recall letter
rates.text: Per letter, including paper, envelope and Austrian domestic postage.

rates.title: Document storage above 20 GB
rates.text: Per gigabyte per month, measured on the last day of the month.

rates.title: Card-terminal transaction
rates.text: Per completed card payment. The terminal's own bank fees are separate.

rates.title: Additional treatment address
rates.text: Per address per month, counted on the first day of the month.

rates.title: Restore from an archived backup
rates.text: Per restore older than 90 days. Restores inside 90 days are free.
